multiScreenGuideStep1: Each display opens in its own browser window, which the pop-up blocker stops by default. Open {{path}} and add this site under Allowed. Or, after your first Apply, click the blocked pop-up icon in the address bar and choose Always allow.
multiScreenGuideStep2: The preview shows which panels go to each display. This window is the monitor you're on now; Display 2 onward are your other monitors, left to right.
multiScreenGuideStep3: Every display opens on its own monitor with its panels loaded. If one is still blocked, its panels stay in this window until you open it.
popupSetupTitle: One-time setup: let this site open your displays
popupSetupSummary_one: Your browser blocked 1 display window. Its panels are in this window for now, so nothing is hidden.

popupSetupStep1: Click the blocked pop-up icon at the right end of the address bar.
popupSetupStep2: Choose "Always allow pop-ups and redirects" for this site, then click Done.

popupSetupOnce: You only do this once in this browser. After that, every display opens on the first click.
